svg.title: How Jane works
svg.desc: Daytime: the child plays in a browser; the Jane app (static UI plus a plain-code engine on the Marble skill graph) grades answers and saves progress to the progress store. No AI runs here. Nighttime, about 1 AM: the parent's bot backs up, exports progress, writes the next quest per LESSONS.md, validates it with publish-lessons.mjs, publishes the content pack and verifies progress is unchanged. The same app deploys to Cloudflare Workers + KV, a Node server with JSON files, or Docker. Another family imports the bot template, their bot reads BOT-SETUP.md and installs their own copy; child data stays in each home.

text.tspan: The app teaches by day. A bot plans by night. No AI runs while your kid plays.
No AI here: fast, predictable, private
AI works offline, ahead of time
Deploy it your way: the same app everywhere
report. The bot sends a short note
Another family gets their own copy:
* Play never calls an AI or outside service. Node and Docker run on your home network with no API key or cloud account, and Jane keeps working if the bot skips a night.
